name: mcp-linkedin-browser
description: Drive LinkedIn from Claude via your installed Chrome — view profiles, search people/jobs/companies, message, connect, react, comment, and update your own profile.
long_description: A standalone MCP server that drives your INSTALLED Google Chrome (no separate app, no browser download). Install in one click; on the first LinkedIn action a Chrome window opens so you log in once, then it drives that session. Write actions are disabled by default and gated behind an explicit opt-in.

allow_mutations.title: Enable write actions
allow_mutations.description: Comma-separated allowlist of write actions to enable (e.g. send_message,comment,update_profile), or "all". Leave blank to keep every write action DISABLED (read-only). Write actions affect your real LinkedIn account.

tools.name: linkedin_login
tools.description: Start the manual login flow.

tools.name: linkedin_logout
tools.description: Clear the stored LinkedIn session: deletes the saved storageState and clears the persistent browser profile cookies so the next action requires a fresh manual login.

tools.name: linkedin_status
tools.description: Return the current driver/session status: lifecycle state, whether a LinkedIn session is authenticated, and whether the persisted session cookies are still valid.

tools.name: linkedin_get_profile
tools.description: Open and scrape a LinkedIn member profile.

tools.name: linkedin_update_profile
tools.description: Update the SIGNED-IN user's OWN profile. Write action.

tools.name: linkedin_search_people
tools.description: Run a People search and return normalized result cards (name, headline, location, profile URL, connection degree).

tools.name: linkedin_search_jobs
tools.description: Run a Jobs search and return normalized job postings (title, company, location, posted date, workplace type, salary if shown, job URL).

tools.name: linkedin_search_companies
tools.description: Run a Company search and return normalized company cards (name, industry, size, company URL).

tools.name: linkedin_send_message
tools.description: Send a direct message to an existing 1st-degree connection (or an open-profile / InMail-eligible member). Write action.

tools.name: linkedin_send_connection
tools.description: Send a connection request to a member, optionally with a personalized note. Write action.

tools.name: linkedin_get_invitations
tools.description: List pending RECEIVED connection invitations from the invitation manager.

tools.name: linkedin_get_sent_invitations
tools.description: List pending connection invitations YOU sent (invitation manager, Sent tab): name, headline, profile URL, profileId, and the "Sent N days ago" label.

tools.name: linkedin_get_connections
tools.description: List your 1st-degree connections, most recently added first: name, headline, profile URL, profileId, and connectedDate (YYYY-MM-DD).

tools.name: linkedin_accept_invitation
tools.description: Accept a pending RECEIVED connection invitation, identified by the inviter’s profileId (vanity slug, as returned by linkedin_get_invitations) or their full profile URL. Write action.

tools.name: linkedin_withdraw_invitation
tools.description: Withdraw a pending SENT connection invitation, identified by the recipient’s profileId (vanity slug) or their full profile URL. Write action.

tools.name: linkedin_react
tools.description: React to a post by its permalink URL with one of LinkedIn’s six reactions (like, celebrate, support, love, insightful, funny). Write action.

tools.name: linkedin_comment
tools.description: Post a comment on a post by its permalink URL. Write action.

tools.name: linkedin_apply
tools.description: Apply to a LinkedIn job via Easy Apply. Write action.

tools.name: linkedin_get_member_posts
tools.description: List a member’s recent posts (newest first) with their canonical permalink URLs and a short text preview, by reading their recent-activity page.

tools.name: linkedin_get_feed
tools.description: Read the home feed and return normalized posts (author, author URL, text, posted time, like/comment counts, post URL).

tools.name: linkedin_get_notifications
tools.description: Read the notifications panel and return normalized notification items (type, actor, text, timestamp, target URL, read/unread state).

tools.name: linkedin_get_conversations
tools.description: List the message threads in the LinkedIn inbox as normalized conversation summaries (participant, snippet, conversation id, timestamp, unread state).

tools.name: linkedin_get_messages
tools.description: Read one message thread and return its messages in order (sender, text, timestamp).

tools.name: linkedin_get_quota
tools.description: Report today's usage of the daily safety caps on mutating actions (connection, message, reaction, comment).
